accession_export: Search Cannabis sativa L. accessions in the GRIN-Global public website.
Use the Results export control to export accession/passport results as CSV or spreadsheet.
Preserve ACCESSION and any PUID/source identifiers.
observation_export: From accession results, select View Observation Data.
Use Export to create a CSV containing all displayed observation data.
Retain GRIN descriptor/trait labels exactly in the raw landing copy.

rules: Never scrape the display HTML when the official CSV/Excel export is available.
Normalize into germplasm/phenotype JSONL and quarantine unknown fields.
Do not conflate NPGS physical-material distribution/SMTA rules with public metadata reuse.
Run accession and BioSample are identity anchors; cultivar/sample display names are not sufficient identifiers.
Preserve BioProject, BioSample, Run, platform and library metadata.
Do not assign GRIN accession IDs unless the public source explicitly links them.
Do not translate coordinates between assemblies without a recorded liftover.
